description: This source file contains implementations for data generation classes related to Azure Event Hubs streaming in Orleans, including classes for generating stream event data and managing streams within an Event Hub partition.

classes.name: SimpleStreamEventDataGenerator
classes.description: Generates stream event data for a specific stream, producing EventData instances with simulated data and sequence management.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionDataGenerator
classes.description: Manages multiple stream data generators within a single Event Hub partition, coordinating data generation for multiple streams.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Attempts to generate up to maxCount EventData items for the stream(s).

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory function to generate SimpleStreamEventDataGenerator instances.

methods.name: AddDataGeneratorForStream
methods.description: Adds a new data generator for a specific stream to the partition generator.

methods.name: StopProducingOnStream
methods.description: Stops data production for a specific stream.
